_meta.baseline: MC Next Growth/Advanced, Sept 2026. Refresh each release (see SKILL.md Step 1).

status_levels.adapt: Element exists but config, data source or behaviour differs. Rebuild with changes.
status_levels.rearchitect: No equivalent. Needs a different pattern (subflow, Apex action, segment logic, data prep).
status_levels.drop: Journey Builder artefact with no business logic. Omit.

EmailAudience.note: DE entry. Source DE must be ingested to Data 360 and rebuilt as a segment. Flow runs on last PUBLISHED segment, not live DE state.

AutomationAudience.note: Automation-fed DE entry. The upstream SQL/automation becomes segment logic or a Data 360 transform; the schedule becomes the segment publish schedule.

SalesforceObj.note: Salesforce Data entry. MC Next runs on core, so trigger straight off the CRM object. Remove the MC Connect sync dependency.

APIEvent.note: Caller must publish a Platform Event or stream via Ingestion API. Every upstream integration changes.

ContactAudience.note: Audience Builder / filtered contact entry. Rebuild filter as a segment.

Loyalty.note: Loyalty Management generated journey (keys PL_/AJP_/FSU_/FP_). Trigger on the Loyalty object (TransactionJournal, Referral) in core. Check whether Loyalty now ships its own MC Next flows before rebuilding.

CloudPages.note: SmartCapture/CloudPage event. Replace with an MC Next form, then trigger off the resulting record.

Unknown.note: Entry source not recognised. Resolve the event definition manually.

MultipleEntries.pattern: Default Flow behaviour. Add duplicate guard only if the same record can re-enter while still in flow.

OnceAndDone.pattern: No native 'no re-entry'. Exclude prior entrants in the segment (engagement or campaign-member based), or stamp a flag field on first entry and check it in a Decision.

SingleEntryAcrossAllVersions.pattern: As OnceAndDone, and the guard must survive flow version changes. Use a durable field or Campaign Member, never flow-local state.

ReentryOnlyAfterExit.pattern: Guard on 'currently in flow'. Use Campaign Member status set on entry and cleared at every terminal path.

EMAILV2.note: Content rebuilt separately (see AMPscript audit). Send classification, sender profile and publication list map to MC Next sender config and subscription consent.

EMAIL.note: Legacy email activity. Same as EMAILV2.

SMSSYNC.note: Sender (short/long code) re-provisioned in MC Next. Inline AMPscript in SMS body goes to content audit. Blackout window must be re-implemented (see blackout flag).

SMS.note: Legacy SMS activity. Same as SMSSYNC.

PUSHNOTIFICATIONACTIVITY.note: MobilePush apps must be re-registered. Confirm MC Next push availability for the edition.

INAPPACTIVITY.note: Confirm availability. Often replaced by Personalization web/app decisions.

WAIT_attribute.note: Date attribute must exist on the triggering record or Data Graph.

WAIT_event.note: Event must exist as an MC Next engagement or Data Cloud event.

WAIT_terminal.note: Trailing short wait with no next step. Journey Builder path terminator. No Flow equivalent needed.

STOWAIT.note: Confirm STO is enabled in the MC Next org.

MULTICRITERIADECISION.note: Decision reads Data Graph attributes on Unified Individual. Every attribute referenced must be on the Data Graph. See per-condition flags.

ENGAGEMENTDECISION.note: Rebuild as wait-for-click/open with timeout branch. Prefer clicks: opens are inflated by privacy proxies.

RANDOMSPLIT.note: Advanced edition only. On Growth: rearchitect with a random-number field and Decision.

PATHOPTIMIZER.note: Advanced edition only. Winner-selection rules differ, re-specify.

EINSTEINSPLIT.note: Einstein Engagement Scoring persona split. Rebuild with Data 360 calculated insight or scoring attribute plus Decision.

EINSTEINFREQUENCYSPLIT.note: Rebuild with a frequency calculated insight plus Decision.

UPDATECONTACTDATA.note: Writes to a DE. No DE in MC Next. Write to a CRM field (Update Records) or drop if the DE only served MCE logic.

SALESCLOUDACTIVITY.note: Native core DML. Simpler than MCE. Watch recursion if it touches the triggering object.

REST.note: Custom Journey Builder activity. Rebuild as invocable Apex or External Service. Owner and endpoint needed.

EVENT.note: Journey-to-journey handoff. Model as subflow call.

_default.note: Unrecognised activity type. Inspect manually and add to mapping_rules.json.

flags.event_attribute: Uses journey entry data (Event.*). In MC Next the attribute must be on the Data Graph or the triggering record; entry payload is not carried like Journey Data.
flags.contact_attribute: Uses a Contact Builder attribute group. Map the source DE to its DMO and confirm the field is on the Data Graph.
flags.reference_join: Compares two attributes across objects (ValueIsReference). Needs a Data Graph related-object path or a pre-computed field. Highest-risk condition type.
flags.list_operator: Whole-word list match. Rebuild as an IN-style condition or, for long hard-coded lists, move the list into data (lookup attribute).
flags.hardcoded_list: Hard-coded ID list in a decision (store keys, codes). Candidate to move into data so the flow does not need edits when the list changes.
flags.sms_blackout: SMS blackout window configured. Re-implement with a Wait Until time-of-day or the MC Next SMS quiet-hours setting (verify).
flags.subject_ampscript: AMPscript in subject line. Route to content audit; subject personalisation syntax changes.
flags.sms_ampscript_lookup: SMS body runs Lookup(). Pre-flatten the value onto the Data Graph.
flags.mixed_data_sources: Single condition set mixes entry data and contact-model data. Both must resolve from one Data Graph in MC Next.
flags.dormant: No contact processed in the dormancy window. Candidate to retire rather than migrate.
flags.exit_criteria: Has exit criteria. MC Next exit criteria: max 10 conditions, evaluated at entry and after each wait.
flags.goal: Has a goal. No native goal. Model as exit criteria plus Campaign Member status for reporting.
flags.spacer_wait: Short (≤5 min) wait between steps. Usually a Journey Builder spacer. Confirm intent, else omit.
